evidence.quote: Applicants who would like to apply for a Bachelor course as a part of the study program International Studies in Engineering (ISE) must first use the application portal of uni-assist.
Prospective students from non-EU countries submit their application to uni-assist (see application deadline).

notes: The DAAD page and the UDE pages state that there are no tuition fees for this programme; no specific fee for non-EU students is mentioned. Some university-wide admission pages show an English B2 requirement and a German DSH-2 requirement that are general for the university, while the programme pages (ISE/Mechanical Engineering) state English B1 and German B1 for enrolment. The programme is taught half in German and half in English, so both languages are included.

note.fr: Vérifiez que vous avez bien étudié les mathématiques lors des 3 dernières années de votre scolarité et obtenu une note équivalente à 2,5 (système allemand) ou mieux.
note.en: Check that you have studied mathematics in the last 3 years of your prior education and achieved a grade of 2.5 (German grading system) or better.

evidence.quote: Applicants must prove that they have studied mathematics in the last 3 years of the previous education entitling them to direct university access and have graduated with a grade of 2.5 (German grading system) or better.
Proof of course grades in Mathematics of 2.5 or better (or equivalent grades) during the last three years prior to the application for this study programme

note.fr: Après l'admission, vérifiez les conditions d'obtention du diplôme : niveau B2 en allemand et en anglais exigé comme condition de fin d'études.
note.en: After admission, check graduation conditions: level B2 in both German and English is required as a condition of graduation.

evidence.quote: Studying in a Bachelor's program in ISE requires proof of level B2 in both languages as a prerequisite for graduation.
Study in a bachelor's degree program in ISE requires proof of level B2 in both languages as a condition of graduation.
